WITH gender_order_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE CAST(o.date_order_placed AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44'
  GROUP BY c.gender
)
SELECT gender, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM gender_order_counts) AS above_average
FROM gender_order_counts
WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM gender_order_counts);
